pkgmetadata.longdescription: The WebOS Linux kernel: upstream LTS plus a deliberately small performance patch series (BORE scheduler, Wine fsync/ntsync, TCP BBRv3, AMD P-State preferred cores) configured for a gaming desktop with CONFIG_HZ=1000, full preemption and zstd zram.

use.flag: Build and install a dracut initramfs after compiling.
Compress the initramfs with zstd instead of gzip.
Keep un-stripped modules and enable debug info.
